chat.t:
Official Notice from Chronoscholar
Dear Subject,
We are pleased to inform you that following the review of your application for the magic experiment, your selection as a test subject has been finalized.
In regard to this matter, a member of our family will personally visit your residence tomorrow
to escort you, so please follow their guidance upon arrival.
Lastly, we express our deepest gratitude for your cooperation and willingness to participate in this experiment.
Sincerely, Head of Chronoscholar

o: ? What is this?
I never applied for any experiment, though

chat.t:
Additional Notice from Chronoscholar
Dear Subject
We have received your expression of non-participation. However, please be advised that this magic experiment has already been confirmed with you as the subject, and cannot be canceled or changed.
Therefore, our staff will visit your residence tomorrow as scheduled. Please be prepared and follow their instructions.
The next experiment will be held at Chronoscholar Manor.
I'll send you the address and time before the experiment, so make sure you're not late.

o: For some reason, I feel like I'm the one losing out here
Should I back out now?

chat.t: Do you really think a contract used by Chronoscholar is just some ordinary contract?
Well, if you want to learn the hard way, I won't stop you.

o: Exploitative company highway robbers
Trash! Boo

chat.t: Say what you want, but you can't back out.
One day, you'll be proud to have been a part of this grand experiment!

lines.t: Hideout
What? Who's visiting at this hour?
Ugh, so noisy! I'm coming, so just wait a second!
Greetings. Since you didn't reply, I, Yuria, Head of Chronoscholar, came to see you per.son.ally.
Congratulations on getting to participate in Chronoscholar's glorious magic experiment. Now, shall we go?
...What? Did you send that spam text yourself?
...Spam?! You were chosen through a completely fair random selection process from among those who actually applied!
Sigh...  First, serve me some tea. Let's talk over a quick drink.
Hold on. For the record, I never agreed to this experiment.
Huh? That can't be right.
Fine. {player}, give me your hand for a second. I have something to check.
...I asked for your hand,  not for you to grope it!
What, did you want me to kiss it instead?
Sigh... Just hold still.
What was that?
It's a simple test. I'm checking if you meet the requirements for this experiment.
And congratulations.  You meet the requirements perfectly.
You didn't even do anything! You already made up your mind before you even checked.
Now, here is the contract. To explain the experiment—
But I refuse.
Why should I participate in some shady magic experiment? It's not like it pays.
Oh? Money? So you'll do it for money?
...Well, that depends on the amount.
Hmm, how about this much for starters?
What... Is it not enough?
!? O-Of course it's n-n-not—
Alright, then I'll raise it to this much.
—Just say the word, Milady.
Should've said so from the start. Shall we go then?
H-Hold on!  Even so, shouldn't you at least tell me what kind of experiment it is?
Oh... Didn't I tell you last time?
I told you this is a "<bouten>Time Interference</bouten>" experiment that I'm personally conducting.
Time Interference?
Yes. We at Chronoscholar have been researching Time Magic for a long time.
And we've finally found the clue to move on to the next phase.
This experiment will go down in history!  And you'll have the honor of being a part of it!
Can I learn that too?
That 'time whatever' magic.
Do you think magic is really that simple?!
Magic is something born from endless years of research and refinement...!
Whatever, just teach me.
If you don't teach me, I'm not doing it.
Hmph. It's not like just anyone can learn it even if I teach them, so feel free to try.
Whether you can actually master it or not is entirely up to you.
Fair enough.
Good. Then the contract is established.  I'll teach you Time Interference Magic,  and you'll be my test subject.
Now, sign here.
Perfect. I'll contact you separately with the schedule.
But what's with that devious look on your face? You're not planning to use magic for something weird, are you?
Of course not. Heh...

chat.t: You didn't forget we have an experiment today, right?

o: Actually, I forgot

chat.t: Sigh... With that level of intelligence, you're basically on par with Flurry.

o: Well, your chest size is smaller than Flurry's.

chat.t: Just don't be late.

o: I'm too lazy to walk. Can't you send a carriage or something?
And preferably with a drop-dead gorgeous driver.
Of course, I wouldn't mind if you came to pick me up either

chat.t: Stop talking nonsense and get over here right now!
Did you get home?
The next experiment involves you actually using magic, so prepare yourself.

o: Prepare myself for what? Am I gonna die?

chat.t: People don't die that easily.
But since it might be mentally taxing...
I've also inscribed protective spells onto the magic circle. Though there might be side effects...

o: What kind of side effects?

chat.t: If I had to name one, your mind will feel extremely clear.
In academic circles, they call this 'Post-Clarity'... I wonder why? It's not like you actually feel any smarter.

o: Hmm...

lines.t: Chronoscholar Laboratory
Hey, I'm here. So what do you want me to do?
Is ignoring me part of the game? Standing around waiting isn't really my style.
You could at least answer when someone calls you. Is drawing that magic circle really that important?
Hyah!
Ekyah!
Mmm... A butt as soft, pillowy, and warm as freshly baked brea—
A-Are..., are you c-c-c-crazy?!?!
I thought you were into ignoring me, but I guess bondage play is more your style.
Ah, but I think the blood is rushing to my head...
Shut up! Do you want to roll around naked on the main street?!
What, we're doing exhibitionism now too?
I said shut up!!
Sigh... Can't you act like a normal person for once?
Would a normal person voluntarily participate in a magic experiment in the first place?
Sigh... How did I end up doing an experiment with a guy like this...
The magic circle was completed while I bickered with Yuria.
Now, step inside. Leave your coat and Quartz outside the circle.
Pretty bold, aren't you?
How far should I strip?
...Just your coat! Is your head filled with nothing but dirty thoughts?
Well... Not really, but there are certain factors that make it hard not to...
Shut up, and  once you're on the circle, I'll hold your hand and channel my mana into you.
It won't take long, so don't worry too much.
If holding hands makes you uncomfortable...
Uncomfortable? I don't know the meaning of the word.
Sigh... I shouldn't have asked.
Step up and hold my hand. I'm going to inscribe the magic on your body now.

...I said hold my hand,
not touch my breasts!!! Seriously, how much of a pervert can you be?!
Oops, my bad.
And stop squeezing my hand...!
Sigh... Here I go.
In a moment, the magic circle will take effect. It might tickle a bit.
Is something supposed to be happening?
Eh? Nothing's happening?
Yeah, I don't feel a thing.
Th-This can't be. My calculations were perfect!
Are you channeling too little mana? Try increasing the output.
If I suddenly pump mana into a single point... it could strain your body, not to mention the magic circle...!
Then can't we just increase the contact area?
What?
Wouldn't increasing the contact area reduce the strain?
Ugh... But...
Ah, whatever! Let's just get this over with quickly!
Chronoscholar is pretty open-minded.
A sudden, bold hug like this.
Sh-Shut up!!
Your heart is beating so fast. Are you about to die?
...Isn't that your heart?! There's no way my heart would be beating this fast!
If you say so.
Take your time. I don't mind holding you for a while.
...Just hold still. I'm finishing this as fast as I can.
...I-It's done. For the next experiment, I'll cast Time Delay Magic on you directly.
Is that it already?
Weren't we supposed to be time traveling?
I-I told you we only found a clue to Time Interference Magic. Today is just the groundwork.
The magic I just cast is to strengthen your body and mind so you can withstand Time Delay Magic.
Oh, so can I smash rocks with my bare hands now?
No, it only increases your durability.
Tch. That's useless.
It's not useless.
Think about it. When the world moves at an extreme speed, all the incoming information gets shoved directly into your brain.
A normal person's head would explode, or their brain would fry and turn them into an idiot.
Whoa, that's terrifying.
That's why I cast the spell on you. Sigh...
I'll contact you for the next session, so you can head home for today.
That was too scary. Give me some energy.
Like another hug?
Or acting cute?
... Get lost!!!

chat.t: Be on time.
I need to test the safety devices.

o: My safety is included in that, right?

chat.t: Who do you think I am?
I can save your life with a single finger.

o: Suddenly I'm feeling uneasy. I'm not going.
Then at least raise my pay for the experiment.
Do you know how many commissions I've had to turn down because of this experiment?

chat.t: As if anyone would even commission a run-down Fixer Office like yours
Don't worry, Chronoscholar will be perfectly fine even if we pay you two or three times your annual income.

o: Then pay me 100 times the amount.

chat.t: Is that all? Simple enough.

o: ...The money is great, but for some reason, I feel like I lost.

chat.t: ...Just shut up and get over here.
This won't happen next time
Today was just an anomaly
I'm the Head of Chronoscholar
There's no way I would fail a spell.
Reply to me if you read this!

o: I got it
Stop texting me, the notifications are getting annoying

chat.t: Hmph
And don't go telling anyone about what happened today.
Don't reply to this.

lines.t: Chronoscholar Laboratory
You're late. I've been waiting for ten minutes.
Being this late is standard, isn't it? There's even a name for it.
...I feel like I lose brain cells whenever I talk to you.
So, what are we doing today?
Pardon me for a second.
Whoa, why are you suddenly throwing things...
Looks like the protective spell is still working perfectly.
Now, let's do a real test. I'm going to lightly tap you with a tentacle.
If the defense magic is working properly, you won't feel a thing, so don't worry.
What are you planning to do with those tentacles?
You're planning to bully me! Just like in those dirty manga!
...I-I have no such intentions! And what do you mean, 'dirty manga'?! Where did that come from?!
Aren't you enjoying this? You like dirty movies too, don't you?
Wh-What are you talking about?! Hmph!
Just hold still. I'll get this over with quickly.
That makes me even more nervous.
There's no way the magic I cast won't work.
Just stand still.
...Kyaah! What is this...?!
L-Let me go...!
...Phew.
Haa... Ngh... Ahaa...
...Forget everything you saw here today.
What exactly should I forget?
That the experiment failed?
That you clung to me crying and begging for help?
...Get out! You idiot!!!

I managed to escape from the Chronoscholar in one piece
before Yuria could actually kill me.

chat.t: Come to the laboratory today as well.
We have to find the cause of last time's failure.
Aren't you going to reply since you've read it?

o: K

chat.t: ...I've seriously never met anyone who acts like you in my entire life.
Hurry up. Don't be late today.

o: But today feels like a good day to be late.
You should be late too.
Just lie in bed and roll around or something.

chat.t: ...Suit yourself.
Just don't be too late.

o: Why are you so nice today? Are you sick or something...?

chat.t: Whatever. See you later.

o: Hey
No reply, huh?
Reply when you've cooled down

lines.t: Chronoscholar Laboratory
*Ugh...* I'll never get used to this place, no matter how many times I come here...
What do you mean you'll never get used to it?
Whoa, holy crap!!! Where did you suddenly pop out from?
Hmph, why are you blaming me for your own slow reflexes? I was repairing a magic circle. Got a problem?
A magic circle? Why?
The defensive magic I placed on you somehow became distorted... and warped the flow of mana.
This has never happened before... and because of it, the magic circle and the tentacles were all affected.
*Sigh...* I think this is going to require some further investigation later...
Can you summarize that? In three lines or less.
You really hate thinking, don't you? Fine, figure it out yourself.
First, I'm going to nullify the magic on you and cast it again.
I need to extract your mana first, so give me your hand for a second.
...Done. Now, go rest somewhere like last time while I finish modifying the magic circle.
Then I'll just mess around like last time to pass the—
Is getting hung from tentacles your hobby? Just stay still.
Yes, ma'am.
(But I can't resist this.)
Poke her belly button.
Gently stroke her belly.
Kyaaaah!!
What do you think you're doing!!!
Sorry. It looked so soft, I couldn't help myself.
But is there a problem?
...D-Do you even know what you just did?
The magic circle I spent days working on is completely ruined now!!!
You don't even know what this means!!
Can't you just erase it and draw it again?
Do you think it's really that simple?!
Every single geometric shape requires complex calculations!
If even one thing is off, the whole thing collapses! And you're just messing around, totally clueless...!
I should never have chosen an idiot like you in the first place...!!
Get out right now!!!
...Fine, I messed up this time.
I said get out!!!!
...Alright, alright. I'm going.
Contact me when you've cooled down.

o: Still mad?
We were supposed to run the experiment today
Are you really ending it like this?
Are you really not going to see me?
K, got it
Hey.
Is it really okay to kick out the person you missed so much?
You said you wanted to see me

chat.t: I-I... When did I ever say that?!
...And the experiment isn't over yet.
Which means we'll be seeing each other again.
...So until the experiment is over, you have to stay by my side.

o: No way.
I'm a free man.

chat.t: Unfortunately, I didn't write an expiration date in the contract
The contract is valid until I declare the experiment is over.
Forever!

o: You're a complete highway robber.

lines.t: I broke into the Chronoscholar to cheer up a sulking Yuria.
Chronoscholar Manor Corridor
Is it really okay for me to get in this easily?
Chronoscholar's security is a joke.
Anyway, where is Yuria hiding now?
(Sob... I hate everything... This is seriously the worst...)
(I could have just drawn a new magic circle, so why did I say that again...)
...What, so you were in your room this whole time?
By the way, what's with the shut-in mode? Your hospitality is terrible.
Hey!
Haven't you noticed me yet?
Hyaah!?This is trespassing!
W-Why... why didn't the detection magic trigger?!
Don't you have something else you should be saying to me?
...I have nothing to say.
Oh, really? Because I do.
Hmm, still a stubborn little head of the house, I see.
If you keep this up, you'll probably end up sulking forever because you missed your chance to apologize.
Ah, maybe I should go tell the others that Yuria is crying all by herself again...
W-Wait! Stop right there! What do you think you're doing?!
Finally showing your face.
Hey. I'm only going to say this once.
...I'm sorry.
I'm not really the type to say sorry, but...
It's an absolute fact that I ruined the magic circle you worked so hard on. So, I apologize.
...Are you just going to stand there? I actually swallowed my pride to apologize, so don't make this awkward for me.
T-That's... not it...
T-That's...
You... you, get over here...!
Whoa...?!
Chronoscholar Manor Corridor
Where did the girl who just confessed so honestly go?
Hello?
...A-At least give me some time to be embarrassed in peace!
*Sigh...* And next time, come through the front door.
Because I'll...   allow it.
Becoming an official guest of the Chronoscholar is pretty exciting.
Since we're here, should I stay for lunch? Or maybe dinner?
J-Just go home already!
